statement: Proton's pinned controller documentation describes Wine/SDL/HID controller input routing, while the inspected Wine winebus source models input-device identity. These sources do not establish whether Proton or the proprietary Steam client automatically correlates a Sony HID controller with an ALSA/PipeWire audio endpoint. Steam's closed-source client association behavior is unknown; verifying it requires an open-source implementation or scoped live consumer observations rather than inferring it from HID recognition.

applicability.scope: Open-source scope: Proton docs/CONTROLLERS.md and Wine winebus HID enumeration, SDL PS5 HIDAPI driver; no Steam client source or live probe.
